steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json to define the app name and package name for Loading Progress Showcase.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle with Android SDK 34, Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, and Java 17.

steps.title: Declare Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate activity configuration, themes, and namespace validation.

steps.title: Design main application layout XML
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout featuring modern Material overlays, loading progress indicators, animated loaders, task lists, and controls.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity state
steps.description: In MainActivity.java, declare UI components, task state, handlers, and helper animation tools.

steps.title: Implement smooth fade transition helpers
steps.description: Write safe fade-in and fade-out animation utilities using Android's built-in AlphaAnimation to meet smooth transition requirements.

steps.title: Create startup loading simulation
steps.description: Implement a splash loading overlay with an animated circular progress indicator that fades out safely after tasks initialize.

steps.title: Develop Task Saving loading UI flow
steps.description: Wire up the Add Task form to simulate network or file saving with progress loaders, disabling active buttons, and handles simulated network errors.

steps.title: Develop Reset Tasks loading UI flow
steps.description: Wire up the Reset Tasks function to show a fullscreen progress state while resetting items to simulate a heavy operation safely.

steps.title: Integrate Error Simulation controls
steps.description: Create switches or triggers to intentionally trigger failures, showing a proper error state dialog or inline text alerts with clean loader dismissals.

steps.title: Perform layout optimization and asset cleanup
steps.description: Verify UI elements scale cleanly, use built-in system drawable references, and run validation checks.

steps.title: Building Loading Progress Showcase
steps.description: Assemble and compile the complete application using the Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2 environment.
